context: Wait for the bound run, verify its immutable head SHA and conclusion, enumerate every job whose name contains windows-latest, require each conclusion to be success, and route any unrelated platform failure to explicit tracked work before completion.
description: Workflow-dispatch run 30722677619 is bound to integrated develop SHA 83205d79054fa847070cd73a0adcae199c667adc after PRs #1445, #1450, and #1455 merged. Require the run to complete successfully and inspect every Windows job rather than relying on a failure-count grep.

anti_patterns.dont: Count FAILED lines through a vacuous xargs pipeline
anti_patterns.instead: Read structured run and job conclusions with gh JSON
anti_patterns.why: Missing run or job IDs can produce a false zero

anti_patterns.dont: Treat an overall workflow failure as a Windows failure without inspecting jobs
anti_patterns.instead: Separate Windows acceptance from unrelated platform triage
anti_patterns.why: The previous proof run exposed an independent macOS test race

preserves.behavior: No Windows job is omitted by selecting only one Python version
The proof stays bound to run 30722677619 and its immutable head SHA
Unrelated platform failures are inspected and explicitly routed before completion

verifications.command: test "$(gh run view 30722677619 --json status,conclusion,headSha --jq '[.status,.conclusion,.headSha] | join(" " )')" = "completed success 83205d79054fa847070cd73a0adcae199c667adc"
verifications.description: Bound workflow run completed successfully on the integrated develop SHA
verifications.expected: fails on the unfixed or incomplete state while run 30722677619 is queued, running, unsuccessful, or bound to a different SHA; passes only after successful completion on SHA 83205d79054fa847070cd73a0adcae199c667adc

verifications.command: test "$(gh run view 30722677619 --json jobs --jq '[.jobs[] | select(.name | test("windows-latest")) | select(.conclusion != "success")] | length')" = 0
verifications.expected: fails on the unfixed tree or while any windows-latest job is queued, running, cancelled, skipped, or failed; passes only when every matching job concluded success

work_units.evidence: Run 30722677619 completed success on immutable head SHA 83205d79054fa847070cd73a0adcae199c667adc.
work_units.summary: Verify the bound run SHA and wait for completion

work_units.evidence: All five Windows jobs succeeded: integration smoke 91428896937, binary framing 91428896956, full Python 3.10 91428896982, full Python 3.12 91428897012, and package 91428897025.
work_units.summary: Enumerate every Windows job and require successful conclusions

work_units.evidence: The complete workflow concluded success with zero failed jobs; no unrelated platform failure required routing.
work_units.summary: Inspect and route any non-Windows failure

work_units.evidence: Structured verification passed for run status, conclusion, head SHA, and zero non-success windows-latest jobs; durable evidence is https://github.com/joeharris76/BenchBox/actions/runs/30722677619.
work_units.summary: Record final run and Windows job evidence
